products.name: Mini Pumpkins
products.description:
Description: Adorable and vibrant, these mini pumpkins are perfect for seasonal decor or adding a festive touch to your table. Great for decorating or cooking small-batch recipes.

Specifications:

Size: Approximately 2-4 inches in diameter
Weight: 4-6 oz per pumpkin
Color: Deep orange with a smooth surface
Key Features:

Ideal for autumn decorations, crafts, and centerpieces
Edible and perfect for small-batch pumpkin recipes
Long-lasting freshness for display
